May 1, 2018 - By Dolores Ford
California Public Employees Retirement System increased its stake in Western Digital Corp (WDC) by 3.92% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. California Public Employees Retirement System bought 25,827 shares as the company’s stock rose 14.25% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 684,148 shares of the electronic components company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $54.41M, up from 658,321 at the end of the previous reported quarter. California Public Employees Retirement System who had been investing in Western Digital Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $23.45 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 2.58% or $2.09 during the last trading session, reaching $78.79. About 6.73 million shares traded or 76.89% up from the average. Western Digital Corporation (NASDAQ:WDC) has risen 17.32% since May 1, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 5.77% the S&P500.
Front Barnett Associates Llc increased its stake in Chevron Corporation (CVX) by 2.58% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Front Barnett Associates Llc bought 2,674 shares as the company’s stock declined 8.26% with the market. The institutional investor held 106,231 shares of the integrated oil company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $13.30 million, up from 103,557 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Front Barnett Associates Llc who had been investing in Chevron Corporation for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $239.08B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.19% or $1.51 during the last trading session, reaching $125.11. About 7.63M shares traded or 1.70% up from the average. Chevron Corporation (NYSE:CVX) has risen 7.88% since May 1, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 3.67% the S&P500.
California Public Employees Retirement System, which manages about $73.97B US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in M T Bank Corp (NYSE:MTB) by 11,166 shares to 407,831 shares, valued at $69.74 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Unit Corp (NYSE:UNT) by 18,342 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 208,052 shares, and cut its stake in Evercore Partners Inc (NYSE:EVR).
